intro: Transform small spaces with Franky—a table that brings versatility & style to your home. With its thoughtful size, it fits snugly into any corner, offering a sturdy surface for meals, work, or play​.

features.title: Durable MDF top
features.text: No need to worry about spills or humidity. Made with high-density moisture-resistant board, this tabletop stays durable and beautiful in any environment.

features.title: Stone-inspired finish
features.text: Bring warmth and texture to your space. The natural stone pattern in suede offers a modern look with a cosy feel.

features.title: Safe rounded corners
features.text: Designed with families in mind—rounded corners help prevent bumps, keeping mealtimes safe and stress-free.

features.title: Strong metal legs
features.text: Built to endure everyday life—powder-coated black metal legs provide stability, durability, and corrosion resistance.

features.title: Perfect for compact spaces
features.text: Compact size and timeless design make it a perfect fit for smaller dining rooms or open-plan living spaces.

name: Franky 4-Seater Engineered Wood Square Dining Table
